verdict.rationale: AgentMail is email infrastructure for agents, so AI inbox triage is a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence only shows developer primitives: string labels that agents can attach to messages and threads, keyword search, allow/block lists, webhooks, and MCP tools. These are building blocks a developer could use to construct triage. There is no documented first-party capability that auto-labels, categorizes, or surfaces what needs attention, with steerable or auditable behavior.
